announced on Wednesday that it expects 2026 net profit attributable to ordinary shareholders to increase at least 100% from the prior year.
The company said revenue this year will be driven by higher premium wine business and caviar sales, stronger customer demand, and improved operating efficiency.
The company also expects better operational efficiency and economies of scale to support profitability.
However, it cautioned that the profit estimate is preliminary and actual results may differ.
Despite the profit outlook, TWG shares traded ~3.14% lower at about $0.28 following the announcement.

title: Top Wealth Group sees 2X profit growth for FY26, yet stock falls
